claims.subject: Agility courses (rooftops incl. Seers', Ardougne, Canifis, Pollnivneach; Colossal Wyrm) and the Hallowed Sepulchre
claims.statement: An ordinary death on any rooftop course, on the Colossal Wyrm course or in the Hallowed Sepulchre is an official (run-ending) death on Hardcore Worlds. Hardcore Worlds uses the Hardcore Group Ironman ruleset, and none of these activities is on Jagex's safe list or on the wiki's current Hardcore Worlds safe list (rev 15404671, 17 Nov 2026). No later Jagex post adds them.

sources.title: Update:Hardcore Worlds Are Coming On November 4th
sources.quote: Hardcore worlds will use the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Group_Ironman_Mode#Hardcore_Group_Ironman Hardcore Group Ironman ruleset] for death which is much less forgiving! This ruleset has very few exceptions, which means you should go in with the expectation that 99% of deaths will land you right back in Death's office

sources.title: Update:Hardcore Worlds Are Coming On November 4th (safe list)
sources.quote: That doesn't mean there aren't exceptions though as the following minigames are safe: * Castle Wars * Clan Wars * Soul Wars * The Fremennik Trials ''(only the 4th phase of the duel with Koschei the Deathless)'' * The Resurrection reward for the TzHaar Fight Caves from the Karamja Elite Diary * TzHaar Fight Pit * Zulrah ''(only the Resurrection reward from the Elite Western Provinces Diary)''

sources.title: Hardcore Worlds
sources.quote: Hardcore Worlds follows the same death ruleset as [[Group_Ironman_Mode#Hardcore_Group_Ironman|Hardcore Group Ironman]]. ... The following activities are '''{{colour|green|SAFE}}''' and dying within them will not count as an official death: * Capsizing your [[Boat]] ... * [[Castle Wars]] * [[Clan Wars]] * [[Emir's Arena]] ... * [[Soul Wars]] * [[TzHaar Fight Pit]] * [[Zulrah]]

sources.title: Hallowed Sepulchre
sources.quote: If the player dies inside the Hallowed Sepulchre, their items will be held by the [[Mysterious Stranger (Hallowed Sepulchre)|Mysterious Stranger]] in the lobby.

claims.notes: Re-confirmation only: the classification itself is already settled in F-3003, F-3005 and F-3009. New here: the current wiki Hardcore Worlds page (17 Nov 2026) and the post-launch Update pages (4-20 Nov 2026) add no Agility activity to the safe list. The Sepulchre's item-retention mechanic is an ordinary death mechanic, not a safe-death rule.

claims.statement: Adala is level 49, max hit 4 (Crush, every 4 ticks), aggressive, 60 Hitpoints. The fight stops when either of you is close to death, and the wiki says the combat ends before either dies. This quest is not on any Hardcore Worlds safe list, so if a death did somehow happen it would count.

sources.quote: She is also briefly fought after the player accuses her of murder, though the combat will end before either she or the player dies.

sources.title: Death on the Isle
sources.quote: She is level 49, and has no special mechanics to attack with. Once either of you are close to death, she will stop and claim that she's too weak to kill Livius or you depending on how the fight went.

claims.subject: Rag and Bone Man III: Odd Old Man scripted 'death' and the Tolna death loop
claims.value: UNSAFE_DEATH (policy default: no T1 source says it is safe on Hardcore Worlds; the wiki calls it 'a safe death for hardcore accounts', linking regular Hardcore Ironman)
claims.statement: Rag and Bone Man III has a scripted sequence where the Odd Old Man 'kills' you in one hit, then a loop in which Tolna's heads 'kill' you again. The wiki calls it an illusory sequence and 'a safe death for hardcore accounts', but that wording links the regular Hardcore Ironman page. No Jagex post says it is safe on Hardcore Worlds, which use the stricter Hardcore Group Ironman ruleset, so under company policy it stays UNSAFE.

sources.title: Rag and Bone Man III
sources.quote: ''This next section is done without any items. Your equipment and items will disappear, but you will get them back later in the quest. This is a safe death for [[hardcore]] accounts. If you use the [[Home Teleport|home]] or [[Minigame Teleport|minigame teleports]] at any time during this section, you will be sent outside of the upcoming [[Instance|instanced]] section.

sources.title: Rag and Bone Man III
sources.quote: The Odd Old Man will seemingly kill you in one hit, putting you into an illusory sequence that begins with you being taken to [[Death's Office]]. ... Upon arrival, you will be attacked by Tolna's three-headed forms, like you faced in [[A Soul's Bane]]. You will not be able to kill them, however, and will die again, starting the loop over.

sources.title: Update:Hardcore Worlds Are Coming On November 4th
sources.quote: This ruleset has very few exceptions, which means you should go in with the expectation that 99% of deaths will land you right back in Death's office ready to make a difficult choice.

claims.notes: NEW CONTENT: released 18 Nov 2026 (2 days ago), page edited 20 Nov 2026; volatile. The wiki itself calls the sequence illusory, so it may not be processed as a death at all, but I found no T1 or in-game text confirming how Hardcore Worlds treats it. The Week 3 Update post (rev 15406871) does not mention it. Recommend planners never route this quest (it gives no Agility XP anyway).

claims.value: PvP exists in the Wilderness on Hardcore Worlds (player kills are an official raffle task; PvP deaths follow the normal Wilderness rules)
claims.statement: The Wilderness on Hardcore Worlds is fully PvP. Jagex's Hardcore Worlds raffle includes the task 'Kill another player in The Wilderness' and Wilderness Agility Course lap tasks, and the announcement says PKing deaths proceed as normal. A death to a player killer ends the run like any other unsafe death.

claims.statement: Seers' Gap 1 and the Tightrope can be failed until 79 Agility. Neither the course page nor either obstacle's own page gives a failure damage figure, so the damage is unknown. The general Agility page says failures often deal small damage, and on many courses it depends on current Hitpoints.

The course page says the level 18 and 25 skeletons 'will attack any player near them', and the Aggressiveness page says most Wilderness monsters are aggressive regardless of level. Two of the Agility Pyramid page's routes go through these areas: running south from Pollnivneach, and running north-east from Sophanem. The Nardah routes are not described as passing them.

claims.subject: Escape crystal: scope in the Hallowed Sepulchre and Brimhaven Agility Arena, and forced movement

value.moving_rule: does NOT activate while moving; fires when movement stops
value.jagex_description: an escape option that can activate automatically after no input; Jagex calls it a teleport to your respawn point

claims.statement: No source says whether the escape crystal works in the Hallowed Sepulchre or the Brimhaven Agility Arena. The wiki lists the activities it teleports you out of (seven raids and minigames, plus the Gauntlet), and Jagex describes it generally as an automatic escape and a teleport to your respawn point. It does not activate while you are moving. Whether forced movement on an obstacle or a Sepulchre trap reset counts as moving is not documented.

sources.title: Escape crystal
sources.quote: The crystal acts similarly to a [[respawn teleport]], teleporting players away from various activities, which may count as dangerous deaths for [[Hardcore Ironmen]] and [[Hardcore Group Ironmen]]. {{list|c=1|* [[Barbarian Assault]] * [[Chambers of Xeric]] * [[The Inferno]] * [[Pest Control]] * [[Theatre of Blood]] * [[TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges]] * [[Tombs of Amascut]] }}

sources.title: Escape crystal
sources.quote: The crystal will '''NOT''' activate while the player is moving. If the inactive time is reached at any point during movement, the crystal will activate when the player stops moving.

sources.title: Update:Hardcore Worlds Are Coming On November 4th
sources.quote: If you're not familiar with the Escape Crystal, it's an equippable escape option to help prevent unfortunate deaths from happening in the first place, which can activate automatically when there's been no input for a while, essentially helping you out of situations where you might have disconnected or your device crashes!

sources.title: Update:Hardcore Worlds Are Coming On November 4th
sources.quote: We still want them to have a cost as otherwise they would be free teleports to your respawn point but the current price is very high and we'd like to make it more accessible.

claims.notes: Confidence applies to the finding that the Sepulchre, Brimhaven and forced-movement behaviour are undocumented. The wiki list and the Jagex description do not agree on scope: the wiki enumerates activities, Jagex describes a general escape. Neither the Sepulchre page (rev 15387544) nor the Brimhaven page (rev 15371976) mentions the escape crystal. Only an owner in-game test (T1 in-game observation) can settle it.
